mapper.select: SELECT g.goal_id AS goalId, g.user_id AS userId, g.name AS name, g.target_amount AS targetAmount, (g.initial_amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE goal_id = g.goal_id AND user_id = g.user_id), 0)) AS currentAmount FROM goals g WHERE g.goal_id = #{goalId}

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, SUM(t.amount) AS monthlyAmount FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(t.occurred_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.occurred_at) = #{month} AND t.type = 'EXPENSE'
AND c.is_budgetable = 1 AND c.is_fixed = 0 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY monthlyAmount DESC LIMIT 1
